name: Hall of One Hundred — GLM-5.3
summary: 100 self-contained HTML design studies — sign-in pages, posters, players, terminals, kinetic typography — each with its generation prompt.
description: A single page presenting 100 self-contained HTML studies generated from prompts: an after-dark sign-in, hand-built CSS planets, a brutalist type poster, a working cyberpunk terminal, a neumorphic music player, an editorial spread, a liquid-chrome drink landing page, a kinetic typography stage and a flow-field atlas. Each card opens the piece in its own tab and shows the prompt used to generate it; the same prompts ship as .txt sidecar files.
